chunks: Muhammad ibn Abi ʿUmayr narrated from Hisham ibn Salim, from Sulayman ibn Khalid, from Abu ʿAbdillah عليه السلام, who said:

Amir al-Muʾminin عليه السلام used to say regarding a free man who dies while he has a slave mother: "She should be purchased from the wealth of her son, then freed, then inheritance is effected for her."

key_terms.أُمٌّ مَمْلُوكَةٌ: a mother who is legally enslaved
key_terms.مِنْ مَالِ ابْنِهَا: from the estate or wealth of her son
key_terms.يُوَرَّثُ: inheritance is then carried out for her

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a free man dies and his mother is a slave?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the estate of a free man whose mother is still enslaved at the time of his death. It states that she is first purchased from his wealth, then emancipated, and only after that does she inherit from him.
